title: Rename the agent tools, keep the old names working
request: The intern's and the MCP server's tools follow the rename: propose_solution and set_solution, while existing Chat UI and MCP setups that call the old names keep working.
spec: propose_solution and set_solution for the intern and the MCP server; propose_contract and set_contract still accepted. Done when the intern and MCP tests pass, including a call by an old name.
plan: Rename the tools in dclab_rnd/intern/tools.py and dclab_rnd/mcp_server.py.
Map the old names through a LEGACY_TOOLS table in Toolbox.call.
Update the intern's standard plan and the tests; add a test calling the old names.

decisions.decision: Old tool names are mapped, not listed as separate tools.
decisions.why: Listing both would show a model two tools for one action; mapping keeps old configs working while the model sees only the new names.

change: propose_solution and set_solution in the toolbox and the MCP server; Toolbox.call maps propose_contract and set_contract; the standard plan and tests updated.
outcome: Done: the tools carry the new names and an old call still reaches them (test_old_tool_names_reach_the_new_tools).
lessons: Rename an external interface with an alias table and a test that calls the old name.
